Name: Bearded Elliott
Author: Siana12
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Just like the title says, this mod changes the appearance of Elliott by giving him a beard in both his Portraits and Sprites. This mod functions as an overlay for the original portraits and sprites for Elliott, adding the beard on top of the original sprites. 

It could be compatible with other mods if they look very similar to the original portraits.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the file[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Unzip the file[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Place it into your Mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
This mod is compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic [/url]mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url], but only if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21590]JennericUsername[/url]'s Revisions for Seasonal Outfits mod for 1.6. If you try to use the Seasonal outfits mod without the revisions, it WILL NOT WORK unless you turn off Elliott's portraits.

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Big thanks to my brother for confirming that Elliott looks "slightly more tolerable now." [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I hope you all enjoy! [/color]

Downloads.Description: The portraits and sprites are overlays for the official Elliott Art. This will also work with the seasonal outfits mod (but only with the Elliott revisions by JennericUsername)
